research_scope.source_denominator: sources.json:sources[]; every canonical source card, excluding aliases and nested related-source pointers

research_scope.bias: Initial corpus is predominantly English and methodological, with international/UK/EU/US institutional sources. Local data, authentic law/acts, capacity and rights records require substantive acquisition.

root_source_spot_checks.finding: Official page identifies chapter 9 section 9.2, despite component-11 URL. Corrected card and narrative; scale and household decile definition confirmed.
Official June 2025 version confirms 2021 PPP basis and published lines; no indefinite-currentness claim.
Official W3C 2025 Recommendation section 1.1 distinguishes verifiability from truth; privacy scope retained.

checks.external_web_links: source research with per-card access limits, not a bulk network link check

limitations: Research_access labels summarize source access, not scientific/legal verification. Small document checks prove file integrity, internal links and the stated illustrative arithmetic only. No product authority or claim closure follows.
